name: nitco（ニトコ）
description: nitco 原生形态键（eye_blink_left、eye_zitome、mouth_fun、eyebrows_angry、VRM_lookup 等）。Blink Left / Lowerlid Left 等 VRChat 键是空键，不使用。标了 guessed 的需要游戏实测。
description_en: nitco's native shape keys (eye_blink_left, eye_zitome, mouth_fun, eyebrows_angry, VRM_lookup, ...). The VRChat keys Blink Left / Lowerlid Left and the like are empty and not used. Mappings marked guessed need testing in game.

channels.name: eyebrows_up
channels.note: 眉毛上移；左右合一的键，左右信号各取一半。最大位移 14.1mm（nitco）。整条眉毛上移。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browRaise.L / browRaise.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Brow up; one key for both sides, half of each side's signal. Max displacement 14.1 mm (nitco). Whole brow up. Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browRaise.L / browRaise.R, the larger wins

channels.name: eyebrows_down
channels.note: 眉毛下压；左右合一的键，左右信号各取一半。最大位移 25.9mm（nitco）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browLower.L / browLower.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Brow down; one key for both sides, half of each side's signal. Max displacement 25.9 mm (nitco). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browLower.L / browLower.R, the larger wins

channels.name: eyebrows_sad
channels.note: 眉头上提；左右合一的键，左右信号各取一半。最大位移 10.3mm（nitco）。eyebrows_sad：眉头上提、眉尾下垂
channels.note_en: Inner brow up; one key for both sides, half of each side's signal. Max displacement 10.3 mm (nitco). eyebrows_sad: inner brow up, outer brow down

channels.name: eyebrows_angry
channels.note: 眉头下压（皱眉）；左右合一的键，左右信号各取一半。最大位移 9.4mm（nitco）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browInnerDown.L / browInnerDown.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Inner brow down (frown); one key for both sides, half of each side's signal. Max displacement 9.4 mm (nitco). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browInnerDown.L / browInnerDown.R, the larger wins

channels.name: eye_blink_left
channels.note: 闭眼（左侧）。最大位移 35.1mm（nitco）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 eyeClose.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Eye closed (left). Max displacement 35.1 mm (nitco). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal eyeClose.L, the larger wins

channels.name: eye_blink_right
channels.note: 闭眼（右侧）。最大位移 35.1mm（nitco）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 eyeClose.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Eye closed (right). Max displacement 35.1 mm (nitco). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal eyeClose.R, the larger wins

channels.name: eye_zitome
channels.note: 上眼睑下降、眼裂缩小；左右合一的键，左右信号各取一半。最大位移 9.9mm（nitco）
channels.note_en: Upper lid lowers, eye narrows; one key for both sides, half of each side's signal. Max displacement 9.9 mm (nitco)

channels.name: eye_open
channels.note: 睁大眼；左右合一的键，左右信号各取一半。最大位移 5.6mm（nitco）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 eyeWiden.L / eyeWiden.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Eye wide open; one key for both sides, half of each side's signal. Max displacement 5.6 mm (nitco). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal eyeWiden.L / eyeWiden.R, the larger wins

channels.name: mouth_a
channels.note: 张嘴。最大位移 11.5mm（nitco）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 jawDrop，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth open. Max displacement 11.5 mm (nitco). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal jawDrop, the larger wins

channels.name: mouth_u
channels.note: u 口型（嘴唇收拢）；左右合一的键，左右信号各取一半。最大位移 11.5mm（nitco）
channels.note_en: "u" mouth shape (lips rounded); one key for both sides, half of each side's signal. Max displacement 11.5 mm (nitco)

channels.name: mouth_fun
channels.note: 嘴角上扬；左右合一的键，左右信号各取一半。最大位移 2.0mm（nitco）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 mouthCornerUp.L / mouthCornerUp.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth corner up; one key for both sides, half of each side's signal. Max displacement 2.0 mm (nitco). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal mouthCornerUp.L / mouthCornerUp.R, the larger wins

channels.name: mouth_frown
channels.note: 嘴角下垂；左右合一的键，左右信号各取一半。最大位移 3.6mm（nitco）。唇中上拱的 ∩ 形，嘴角略降。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 mouthCornerDown.L / mouthCornerDown.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth corner down; one key for both sides, half of each side's signal. Max displacement 3.6 mm (nitco). A ∩ shape with the lip centre arched up, the corners drop slightly. Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal mouthCornerDown.L / mouthCornerDown.R, the larger wins

channels.name: mouth_stretch
channels.note: 嘴角向外、嘴变宽；左右合一的键，左右信号各取一半。最大位移 6.0mm（nitco）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 mouthCornerOut.L / mouthCornerOut.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth corner out, mouth wider; one key for both sides, half of each side's signal. Max displacement 6.0 mm (nitco). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal mouthCornerOut.L / mouthCornerOut.R, the larger wins

channels.name: mouth_shrink
channels.note: 嘴角向内、嘴变窄；左右合一的键，左右信号各取一半。最大位移 6.0mm（nitco）
channels.note_en: Mouth corner in, mouth narrower; one key for both sides, half of each side's signal. Max displacement 6.0 mm (nitco)

channels.name: VRM_lookup
channels.note: 虹膜上移。最大位移 4.5mm（nitco）。视线方向按 Shinano 游戏实测换算：虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X) 对应 yaw +1。
channels.note_en: Iris up. Max displacement 4.5 mm (nitco). Gaze direction converted as measured in game on Shinano: iris toward the character's own left (+X) = yaw +1.

channels.name: VRM_lookdown
channels.note: 虹膜下移。最大位移 6.1mm（nitco）。视线方向按 Shinano 游戏实测换算：虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X) 对应 yaw +1。
channels.note_en: Iris down. Max displacement 6.1 mm (nitco). Gaze direction converted as measured in game on Shinano: iris toward the character's own left (+X) = yaw +1.

channels.name: VRM_lookleft
channels.note: 虹膜移向角色左侧。最大位移 12.1mm（nitco）。视线方向按 Shinano 游戏实测换算：虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X) 对应 yaw +1。
channels.note_en: Iris to the character's left. Max displacement 12.1 mm (nitco). Gaze direction converted as measured in game on Shinano: iris toward the character's own left (+X) = yaw +1.

channels.name: VRM_lookright
channels.note: 虹膜移向角色右侧。最大位移 12.1mm（nitco）。视线方向按 Shinano 游戏实测换算：虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X) 对应 yaw +1。
channels.note_en: Iris to the character's right. Max displacement 12.1 mm (nitco). Gaze direction converted as measured in game on Shinano: iris toward the character's own left (+X) = yaw +1.
